item.title: A message from Mr. Warner:
item.description: The junior girls' basketball team will be hosting Osgoode High School tomorrow at 3 pm. All are welcome to attend.

item.title: A message from: Prom Committee.
item.description: An announcement for our gr. 12 students. Tomorrow will be our first Prom meeting at lunch in room 202! This will be a quick kick-off meeting to discuss the venue and date, and start brainstorming fundraising ideas and possible Prom themes.

item.title: A message from Administration:
item.description: Reminder that School Photos for grades 11, 12 and Homerooms 8D & 8B will take place tomorrow, September 15th after lunch.

item.title: A message from Ms. Baron:
item.description: There will be a Best Buddies interest meeting at lunch tomorrow in room 127. All are welcome, whether you are looking to join or just want to know what we are all about.

item.title: A message from Mme Perron:
item.description: There will be a brief Europe team meeting tomorrow at lunch in room 125. All travelers must attend this will not be a long meeting.
